package.name: racer_policy
package.description: The deployment-contract loader (ROS-free: racer_policy.load_contract, verify_against_environment, deploy.load_deployment) and policy_node, which runs a learned residual on top of the tracker's command and publishes /drive_raw only (roadmap 5.2 scaffolding; it does not deploy on hardware and does not pass gate G3). torch is a deploy-time dependency imported lazily; it is not declared here because it comes from the car image, not rosdep.
